chapters.reason: The paper explicitly frames DeltaNet as a gradient-based update rule (delta rule) where the hidden state acts as fast weights, and focuses on hardware-efficient chunk-wise parallelization for training.
The paper describes the delta rule as a form of online learning/optimization where the hidden state is updated to steer toward key-value targets, fitting the gradient-state recurrence definition.
The paper is a linear transformer variant that replaces standard attention with a linear-time alternative, sharing characteristics with associative recurrent neural networks.
